title: Design System: Aadhil Anwar — Quiet Authority

display.purpose: Hero name only. The single largest type on the site.

title.purpose: Section headings (h2). Small by design — density is the voice.

label.purpose: Kickers, dates, tags. The only place tracking widens and mono appears.

motion.name: transition-fast
motion.purpose: Color/background state feedback on links, buttons, nav.

motion.name: transition-base
motion.purpose: Slightly slower state shifts (mobile menu transform).

motion.name: fade-in
motion.purpose: One-time page-load entrance, staggered in the hero, gated behind prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Inverted bright-on-dark button for the single most important action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; background: #ededef; color: #0c0c0e; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.825rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; padding: 0.55rem 1.15rem; border-radius: 6px; text-decoration: none; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #d4d4d8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6e56cf; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ghost button: hairline outline, bright ink, fills on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #ededef; border: 1px solid #23232b; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.825rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; padding: 0.55rem 1.15rem; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #1e1e24; border-color: #5c5c6a; }

components.name: Social Button
components.description: Card-pill link with icon for social profiles.
components.css: .ds-social-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: #18181c; color: #a0a0ab; font-size: 0.825rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 0.4rem 0.85rem; border-radius: 6px; text-decoration: none; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-social-btn:hover { background: #1e1e24; color: #ededef; } .ds-social-btn svg { color: inherit; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Mono metadata tag for CVE ids, tech stack, post categories.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.675rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: #a0a0ab; background: #161619; padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Post Item
components.description: A blog/writeup list row: mono date, title link, hover lift on the title color.
components.html: Jun 14, 2026:Segmentation that holds as the network changes
components.css: .ds-post-item { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.3rem 0; } .ds-post-date { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.775rem; color: #5c5c6a; } .ds-post-sep { color: #5c5c6a; } .ds-post-title { color: #8a8fff; text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: color 150ms ease; } .ds-post-title:hover { color: #a0a4ff; }

narrative.overview: The workspace of someone who reads syslogs for a living and writes things down precisely. Near-black surfaces, small dense type, a single restrained violet that almost never appears. The design reads like a well-configured terminal and a careful engineer's notes: nothing is loud, everything is legible, and the substance carries weight. Density is the signature — type runs small, tracking is tight, layout favors information over whitespace. Minimalism-as-restraint, not minimalism-as-emptiness. A four-tier near-black elevation system creates depth without a single drop shadow.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only, four-tier near-black elevation (#0c0c0e to #1e1e24), no shadows.
Small, dense, tightly-tracked type. Information density over whitespace.
A muted violet accent (#6e56cf) used on under 10% of any screen.
Inter for everything visible; JetBrains Mono reserved for labels, dates, and code.
Motion is a brief, one-time entrance fade; never scroll-triggered decoration.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The violet accent appears on under 10% of any given screen. If a comp has violet in three places above the fold, two of them are wrong.

rules.name: The No-Stripe Rule
rules.body: Color never arrives as a border-left accent bar. Emphasis comes from the ink ramp, a full hairline border, or a background tier shift.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Something Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is reserved for content that is literally code, data, or metadata. Never set prose in mono to look technical.

rules.name: The Quiet Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Display type stops at ~2.5rem. The page states; it does not shout. No clamp() max above 3rem.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. Separate layers by shifting the background tier or adding a hairline, never a drop shadow or glass blur.

dos: Do keep the violet accent (#6e56cf) on under 10% of any screen.
Do convey depth by stepping up the near-black tier ramp and using 1px hairlines, never shadows.
Do reserve JetBrains Mono for real code, data, timestamps, and tags.
Do keep type small and dense with tight tracking; let 1.7 line-height carry readability.
Do let specifics carry credibility, not adjectives.
Do gate every animation behind prefers-reduced-motion and keep entrances to a single page-load fade.
Do keep body text on #a0a0ab or brighter to hold WCAG AA 4.5:1.
donts: Don't do hacker/terminal cosplay: green-on-black, matrix rain, glitch text, skull/lock iconography.
Don't build the SaaS landing template: gradient-text heroes, identical feature-card grids, tracked-uppercase eyebrows, big-number metric blocks.
Don't drift into editorial-magazine affectation: display-serif italics, drop caps, broadsheet column rules.
Don't use background-clip:text gradient text anywhere.
Don't use a border-left/right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't introduce drop shadows or decorative glassmorphism to fake depth.
Don't set #5c5c6a on body-length reading text; it fails AA on the dark backgrounds.
Don't nest cards, or push display type past ~2.5rem.
